unitTitle: Be Going To - Will - Present Continuous - It Will Be/There Will Be
scanNote: 10-mashqning 2-bandida ('It will be fog tomorrow') IKKI xil to'g'ri tuzatish bor: 'fog' → 'FOGGY' (sifat, 'It' qoladi) yoki 'It' → 'THERE' (ot qoladi). Kitobda bitta bo'sh joy bor, shuning uchun ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi. Quyida ikkalasi ham ko'rsatilgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the future simple, be going to or the present continuous. (item 10)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'lni kelasi oddiy zamon, 'be going to' yoki 'present continuous' ga qo'ying. (10-band)
exercises.explanationUz:
58-BETDAGI 6-MAShQNING DAVOMI.

JAVOB:
  10  I can't go to the park today.
      I AM TAKING my dog to the vet.

  (Bugun parkga bora olmayman.
   Itimni veterinarga olib boryapman.)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:
  'I CAN'T GO to the park TODAY.' — nega bora
  olmaydi? Chunki BOShQA BELGILANGAN ishi bor.
  'today' — ANIQ vaqt.
  → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  Bu — 58-betdagi 5-band bilan bir xil naqsh:
  'I can't see you at the weekend.
   I'm visiting my parents.'


ESLATMA:
  'I am going to take my dog to the vet' ham
  grammatik jihatdan mumkin.
  Lekin veterinarga OLDINDAN yozilgan bo'lsa
  (odatda shunday), PRESENT CONTINUOUS tabiiyroq.


YANGI SO'Z:
  a vet (veterinarian) = veterinar, hayvon
                         shifokori

items.textEn: 10  I can't go to the park today. I ............ (take) my dog to the vet.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish.
'I CAN'T GO to the park TODAY' — nega?
Chunki BOSHQA belgilangan ishi bor.
'today' — ANIQ vaqt.

58-betdagi 5-band bilan bir xil naqsh.

ESLATMA: 'am going to take' ham mumkin, lekin
veterinarga oldindan yozilgan bo'lsa
present continuous tabiiyroq.
'a vet' = veterinar.

exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA (56 va 57-betlardan):

  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?
     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  THERE will be FEWER CARS in the future.
  2  IT     will be FOGGY in London tomorrow.
  3  THERE will be SUNSHINE in Madrid next week.
  4  IT     will be HOT in Rome tomorrow.
  5  THERE will be RAIN in Ankara today.
  6  THERE will be LESS POLLUTION in 20 years'
     time.
  7  IT     will be COLD in Prague tomorrow.
  8  THERE will be STRONG WINDS in Paris next
     week.

  IT — UChTA:      2, 4, 7
  THERE — BEShTA:  1, 3, 5, 6, 8


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Kelajakda mashinalar kamroq bo'ladi.
  2  Ertaga Londonda tumanli bo'ladi.
  3  Keyingi hafta Madridda quyoshli bo'ladi.
  4  Ertaga Rimda issiq bo'ladi.
  5  Bugun Ankarada yomg'ir bo'ladi.
  6  20 yildan keyin ifloslanish kamroq bo'ladi.
  7  Ertaga Pragada sovuq bo'ladi.
  8  Keyingi hafta Parijda kuchli shamollar
     bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI — SIFATMI YOKI OT:

  1  'fewer cars'      — OT (ko'plik)   → THERE
  2  'foggy'           — SIFAT ('-y')   → IT
  3  'sunshine'        — OT             → THERE
  4  'hot'             — SIFAT          → IT
  5  'rain'            — OT             → THERE
  6  'less pollution'  — OT             → THERE
  7  'cold'            — SIFAT          → IT
  8  'strong winds'    — OT (ko'plik)   → THERE


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Sifatlarning hammasi HOLATNI bildiradi
  (foggy, hot, cold) — 'IT' bilan.
  Otlarning hammasi NARSANI bildiradi
  (cars, sunshine, rain, pollution, winds) —
  'THERE' bilan.


DIQQAT — 4 va 7-BANDLAR:
  'hot' va 'cold' — bular ob-havo SIFATLARI,
  '-y' bilan tugamaydi, lekin baribir SIFAT →
  'IT will be'.

  Ot shakllari bo'lardi:
     'There will be HEAT.' (issiqlik)
     'There will be COLD WEATHER.' (sovuq ob-havo)


DIQQAT — 1 va 6-BANDLARDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJALAR:
  'FEWER cars'      — 'few' ning qiyosiy shakli
                      (SANALADIGAN otlar bilan)
  'LESS pollution'  — 'little' ning qiyosiy shakli
                      (SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan)

  Bu — Unit 12 dagi noto'g'ri sifatlar:
     few    → fewer  → the fewest
     little → less   → the least

  QOIDA:
     FEWER + SANALADIGAN ot   (fewer cars)
     LESS  + SANALMAYDIGAN ot (less pollution)


ShAHARLAR:
  London  — Britaniya poytaxti
  Madrid  — Ispaniya poytaxti
  Rome    — Italiya poytaxti
  Ankara  — Turkiya poytaxti
  Prague  — Chexiya poytaxti
  Paris   — Fransiya poytaxti

items.textEn: 1  ............ will be fewer cars in the future.
items.whyUz:
'fewer CARS' — OT (ko'plik) → THERE.
DIQQAT: 'FEWER' — 'few' ning qiyosiy shakli,
SANALADIGAN otlar bilan ishlatiladi
('fewer cars' ✓, 'less cars' XATO).

items.textEn: 2  ............ will be foggy in London tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'foggy' — SIFAT ('-y' bilan tugaydi) → IT.
Ot shakli: 'There will be FOG in London
tomorrow.'
Ma'no bir xil.

items.textEn: 3  ............ will be sunshine in Madrid next week.
items.whyUz:
'sunshine' — OT → THERE.
Sifat shakli: 'It will be SUNNY in Madrid next
week.'

items.textEn: 4  ............ will be hot in Rome tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'hot' — SIFAT → IT.
DIQQAT: '-y' bilan tugamaydi, lekin baribir
SIFAT (holatni bildiradi).
Ot shakli 'heat' (issiqlik) bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 5  ............ will be rain in Ankara today.
items.whyUz:
'rain' — OT → THERE.
Sifat shakli: 'It will be RAINY in Ankara
today.'
Ankara — Turkiya poytaxti.

items.textEn: 6  ............ will be less pollution in 20 years' time.
items.whyUz:
'less POLLUTION' — OT → THERE.
DIQQAT: 'LESS' — 'little' ning qiyosiy shakli,
SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan
('less pollution' ✓, 'fewer pollution' XATO).
1-band bilan SOLISHTIRING.

items.textEn: 7  ............ will be cold in Prague tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'cold' — SIFAT → IT.
4-band bilan bir xil qoida.
Praga — Chexiya poytaxti.

items.textEn: 8  ............ will be strong winds in Paris next week.
items.whyUz:
'strong WINDS' — OT (ko'plik) → THERE.
Sifat shakli: 'It will be WINDY in Paris next
week.'

shu juftlik bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: What are they going to do? Match column A to column B.
exercises.instructionUz: Ular nima qilishmoqchi? A ustunni B ustunga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
USTUN A (holat / xohish):
  1  Tom has toothache
     (Tomning tishi og'riyapti)
  2  Amanda likes music
     (Amanda musiqani yaxshi ko'radi)
  3  Chris wants to go on holiday
     (Kris ta'tilga bormoqchi)
  4  Lisa needs to relax
     (Lizaga dam olish kerak)
  5  Dave wants to have a party
     (Deyv ziyofat qilmoqchi)
  6  Jill wants to take some pictures
     (Jill surat olmoqchi)

USTUN B (harakat):
  a  save some money
  b  borrow a camera
  c  send invitations to his friends
  d  visit the dentist
  e  stay at home
  f  take piano lessons


Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → d


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  →  d   visit the dentist
  2  →  f   take piano lessons
  3  →  a   save some money
  4  →  e   stay at home
  5  →  c   send invitations to his friends
  6  →  b   borrow a camera


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — SABAB → HARAKAT:

  1  Tishi og'riyapti → TISh ShIFOKORIGA borish
  2  Musiqani yaxshi ko'radi → PIANINO darslari
  3  Ta'tilga bormoqchi → PUL YIG'ISh
     (ta'til pul talab qiladi)
  4  Dam olish kerak → UYDA QOLISh
  5  Ziyofat qilmoqchi → TAKLIFNOMA yuborish
  6  Surat olmoqchi → FOTOAPPARAT olish

  Har bir juftlik MANTIQAN aniq — taxminga
  o'rin yo'q.


OLMOShLARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  Tom    → HE   (c-bandda 'HIS friends')
  Amanda → SHE
  Chris  → HE
  Lisa   → SHE
  Dave   → HE
  Jill   → SHE

  DIQQAT: c-bandda 'HIS friends' yozilgan —
  demak u ERKAK uchun (Dave).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  toothache = tish og'rig'i (tooth + ache)
  to borrow = qarzga olmoq
  a camera  = fotoapparat
  piano lessons = pianino darslari

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
Tish og'rig'i → tish shifokoriga borish.
'toothache' = tish og'rig'i (tooth + ache).

Musiqani yaxshi ko'rish → cholg'u o'rganish.
'TAKE lessons' = dars olmoq
('make lessons' XATO).

pairs.left: 3  Chris wants to go on holiday
pairs.whyUz:
Ta'til PUL talab qiladi → pul yig'ish.
'save money' = pul yig'moq
('earn money' — ishlab topmoq, boshqa ma'no).

Dam olish → uyda qolish.
'stay AT home' — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q.

pairs.left: 5  Dave wants to have a party
pairs.right: c  send invitations to his friends
pairs.whyUz:
Ziyofat → mehmonlarni taklif qilish.
DIQQAT: b-bandda 'HIS friends' yozilgan —
demak u ERKAK uchun (Dave).
58-betdagi 3-mashqda ham shu ibora bor edi.

pairs.left: 6  Jill wants to take some pictures
pairs.whyUz:
Surat olish → fotoapparat kerak.
'take pictures' = surat olmoq.
'to borrow' = qarzga olmoq
(aksi: 'to lend' — qarzga bermoq).

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences using so, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng 'so' dan foydalanib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom has toothache, SO HE IS GOING TO visit the
   dentist.'


QOLIP:
  [SABAB], SO + ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY
  fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.
  'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi (57-bet qoidasi).


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Tom has toothache, so he is going to visit
     the dentist.                       (NAMUNA)

  2  Amanda likes music, so she is going to take
     piano lessons.

  3  Chris wants to go on holiday, so he is going
     to save some money.

  4  Lisa needs to relax, so she is going to stay
     at home.

  5  Dave wants to have a party, so he is going to
     send invitations to his friends.

  6  Jill wants to take some pictures, so she is
     going to borrow a camera.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tomning tishi og'riyapti, shuning uchun u
     tish shifokoriga bormoqchi.
  2  Amanda musiqani yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun
     u pianino darslariga bormoqchi.
  3  Kris ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun u pul
     yig'moqchi.
  4  Lizaga dam olish kerak, shuning uchun u uyda
     qolmoqchi.
  5  Deyv ziyofat qilmoqchi, shuning uchun u
     do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi.
  6  Jill surat olmoqchi, shuning uchun u
     fotoapparat qarzga olmoqchi.


OLMOShLAR — DIQQAT:
  Tom, Chris, Dave  →  HE  is going to
  Amanda, Lisa, Jill →  SHE is going to

  Hammasi BIRLIK → 'IS going to'.


ESLATMA — SHU GAPLARNI 'BECAUSE' BILAN HAM
AYTISh MUMKIN:
  'Tom is going to visit the dentist BECAUSE he
   has toothache.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib TESKARI.

  Lekin kitob 'SO' ni so'ragan — shuning uchun
  SABAB birinchi, NATIJA ikkinchi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match Cindy's intentions to their reason/purpose.
exercises.explanationUz:
INTENTIONS (niyatlar):
  1  save money            (pul yig'moq)
  2  study hard            (qattiq o'qimoq)
  3  take French lessons   (fransuz tili
                            darslariga bormoq)
  4  stay at home          (uyda qolmoq)
  5  buy a new dress       (yangi ko'ylak sotib
                            olmoq)

REASON/PURPOSE (sabab/maqsad):
  a  go to a party         (ziyofatga bormoq)
  b  relax                 (dam olmoq)
  c  finish university     (universitetni
                            tugatmoq)
  d  buy a car             (mashina sotib olmoq)
  e  get a job in France   (Fransiyada ish topmoq)


Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → d


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  save money          →  d  buy a car
  2  study hard          →  c  finish university
  3  take French lessons →  e  get a job in France
  4  stay at home        →  b  relax
  5  buy a new dress     →  a  go to a party


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — NIYAT → MAQSAD:

  1  Nega pul yig'adi? — MAShINA olish uchun.
  2  Nega qattiq o'qiydi? — UNIVERSITETNI
     tugatish uchun.
  3  Nega fransuz tilini o'rganadi? —
     FRANSIYADA ISh topish uchun.
     ('French' va 'France' — ANIQ bog'liqlik)
  4  Nega uyda qoladi? — DAM OLISh uchun.
  5  Nega yangi ko'ylak oladi? — ZIYOFATGA
     borish uchun.


ENG OSON BAND — 3:
  'take FRENCH lessons' va 'get a job in FRANCE'
  — ikkalasida ham Fransiya bilan bog'liqlik bor.
  Bu bandni birinchi hal qiling.


Coursebook 95-BETDAGI 8-MAShQ BILAN
SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda Tonining niyatlari bor edi:
     save money → go on holiday
     join a gym → keep fit
     stop eating sweets → lose weight
     study hard → pass his exams
     learn English → get a better job

  Bu yerda Sindining niyatlari — o'xshash, lekin
  boshqa maqsadlar bilan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dress   = ko'ylak (ayollar)
  to finish = tugatmoq
  a university = universitet

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
Nega pul yig'adi? — MASHINA olish uchun.
Mashina katta pul talab qiladi.

Nega qattiq o'qiydi? — UNIVERSITETNI tugatish
uchun.
Coursebook 95-betdagi 8-mashqda 'study hard' →
'pass his exams' edi — o'xshash mantiq.

pairs.right: e  get a job in France
pairs.whyUz:
ENG OSON BAND: 'FRENCH lessons' va 'a job in
FRANCE' — ANIQ bog'liqlik.
Bu bandni birinchi hal qiling.
'get a job' = ish topmoq.

Nega uyda qoladi? — DAM OLISH uchun.
8-mashqning 4-bandi ham shu juftlik
('Lisa needs to relax ... stay at home').

Nega yangi ko'ylak oladi? — ZIYOFATGA borish
uchun.
Ziyofatga chiroyli kiyinib boriladi.
'a dress' = ayollar ko'ylagi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun):

  1) 'Cindy is going to save money BECAUSE she
      wants to buy a car.'
  2) 'Cindy wants to buy a car, SO she is going to
      save money.'
  3) 'Cindy is going to save money TO BUY a car.'

  Demak HAR BIR band uchun UChTA gap!


UCh QOLIP:

  1) BECAUSE (sabab):
     'Cindy is going to [NIYAT] BECAUSE she wants
      to [MAQSAD].'

  2) SO (natija):
     'Cindy wants to [MAQSAD], SO she is going to
      [NIYAT].'

  3) TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'Cindy is going to [NIYAT] TO [MAQSAD].'


BARCHA BESh BAND — UChTADAN GAP:

─── 1  save money / buy a car ───     (NAMUNA)
  Cindy is going to save money because she wants
  to buy a car.
  Cindy wants to buy a car, so she is going to
  save money.
  Cindy is going to save money to buy a car.

─── 2  study hard / finish university ───
  Cindy is going to study hard because she wants
  to finish university.
  Cindy wants to finish university, so she is
  going to study hard.
  Cindy is going to study hard to finish
  university.

─── 3  take French lessons / get a job in France ───
  Cindy is going to take French lessons because
  she wants to get a job in France.
  Cindy wants to get a job in France, so she is
  going to take French lessons.
  Cindy is going to take French lessons to get a
  job in France.

─── 4  stay at home / relax ───
  Cindy is going to stay at home because she wants
  to relax.
  Cindy wants to relax, so she is going to stay at
  home.
  Cindy is going to stay at home to relax.

─── 5  buy a new dress / go to a party ───
  Cindy is going to buy a new dress because she
  wants to go to a party.
  Cindy wants to go to a party, so she is going to
  buy a new dress.
  Cindy is going to buy a new dress to go to a
  party.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har banddan bittadan):
  1  Sindi pul yig'moqchi, chunki mashina sotib
     olmoqchi.
  2  Sindi qattiq o'qimoqchi, chunki universitetni
     tugatmoqchi.
  3  Sindi fransuz tili darslariga bormoqchi,
     chunki Fransiyada ish topmoqchi.
  4  Sindi uyda qolmoqchi, chunki dam olmoqchi.
  5  Sindi yangi ko'ylak sotib olmoqchi, chunki
     ziyofatga bormoqchi.


ESLATMA — UCh ShAKLNING FARQI:
  BECAUSE  →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
              ('she wants to ...')
  SO       →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
              ('she is going to ...')
  TO + fe'l →  ergash gapda EGA YO'Q
              ('to buy a car')

  Uchinchi shakl eng QISQA.


Coursebook 95-BETDAGI 8-MAShQ BILAN AYNAN
BIR XIL TUZILISh.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N GAP — HAR BIRIDA BITTA XATO.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  'The exit is UNDER your left.'  →  ON


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  under        →  ON            (NAMUNA)
   2  fog          →  FOGGY
                      (yoki 'It' → 'THERE')
   3  at Saturday  →  ON Saturday
   4  oldest than  →  OLDER than
   5  played good  →  played WELL
   6  didn't painted →  didn't PAINT
   7  the Poland   →  POLAND ('the' olib tashlanadi)
   8  Could he played →  Could he PLAY
   9  some sugars  →  some SUGAR
  10  When         →  WHERE


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (tuzatilgan holda):
   1  Chiqish chap tomoningizda.
   2  Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi.
   3  Biz shanba kuni kasalxonaga boramiz.
   4  Jon Ketrindan katta.
   5  Futbol jamoasi kecha yaxshi o'ynadi.
   6  Pablo Pikasso 'Mona Liza' ni chizmagan.
   7  Varshava — Polsha poytaxti.
   8  U besh yoshida pianino chala olarmidi?
   9  Qahvangizga shakar solaymi?
  10  Yangi xitoy restorani qayerda?


HAR BIR XATONING TURI:

   1  PREDLOG:  'ON your left/right'
      (yo'l ko'rsatish iborasi)
      Coursebook 90-bet, 3-mashqning 5-bandi ham
      shu.

   2  SIFAT/OT:  'It will be + SIFAT'
      'fog' — OT, shuning uchun:
         'It will be FOGGY.'    (sifat)
      yoki 'THERE will be fog.' (ot)
      IKKALASI HAM TO'G'RI.

   3  PREDLOG:  KUN bilan 'ON'
      'ON Saturday' ✓  ('at Saturday' XATO)
      Coursebook 90-bet qoidasi:
         AT + soat, ON + kun/sana, IN + oy/yil.

   4  QIYOSIY DARAJA:  'THAN' bor →
      qiyosiy daraja kerak.
      'oldEST' — orttirma → 'oldER'.
      Unit 12 qoidasi.

   5  SIFAT → RAVISh:  'played' FE'L →
      RAVISh kerak.
      good → WELL.
      Unit 11 qoidasi.

   6  PAST SIMPLE INKOR:  'didn't' dan keyin
      ASOSIY shakl.
      'didn't PAINT' ✓  ('didn't painted' XATO).

   7  ARTIKL:  mamlakat nomlari oldidan 'the'
      QO'YILMAYDI.
      'POLAND' ✓  ('the Poland' XATO).
      ISTISNOLAR: the USA, the UK,
      the Netherlands.

   8  'COULD' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.
      'Could he PLAY' ✓  ('Could he played' XATO).
      Modal fe'llarning umumiy qoidasi.

   9  SANALMAYDIGAN OT:  'sugar' — sanalmaydigan.
      'some SUGAR' ✓  ('some sugars' XATO).

  10  SAVOL SO'ZI:  restoran JOY, vaqt emas.
      'WHERE is the new Chinese restaurant?' ✓
      'When' — vaqt so'raydi, bu yerda mos emas.


XATOLARNING GURUHLARI:
  PREDLOG:        1, 3
  SIFAT/OT/RAVISh: 2, 5, 9
  DARAJA:         4
  FE'L ShAKLI:     6, 8
  ARTIKL:         7
  SAVOL SO'ZI:    10


QAYSI UNITDAN:
   1  Unit 5-6 (yo'l ko'rsatish)
   2  Unit 13 (It/There will be)
   3  Unit 9-10 (vaqt predloglari)
   4  Unit 12 (qiyoslash)
   5  Unit 11 (ravishlar)
   6  Unit 9-11 (past simple)
   7  Unit 1-2 (mamlakatlar)
   8  Unit 9 (could)
   9  Unit 8 (sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan)
  10  Unit 1-3 (savol so'zlari)

items.textEn: 1  The exit is UNDER your left.
items.whyUz:
NAMUNA.
'ON your left / ON your right' — yo'l ko'rsatish
iborasi.
'under your left' MA'NOSIZ.
Coursebook 90-bet, 3-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu.

items.textEn: 2  It will be FOG tomorrow.
items.hintUz: 'fog' — ot; 'It will be' — sifat talab qiladi
items.whyUz:
'IT will be' dan keyin SIFAT kerak,
lekin 'fog' — OT.

IKKI XIL TO'G'RI TUZATISh:
  a) 'fog' → 'FOGGY':
     'It will be FOGGY tomorrow.'
  b) 'It' → 'THERE':
     'THERE will be fog tomorrow.'

Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, ma'no bir xil.
Unit 13 ning asosiy qoidasi (56, 57-betlar).

items.textEn: 3  We are visiting the hospital AT Saturday.
items.whyUz:
KUN bilan 'ON':
'ON Saturday' ✓  ('at Saturday' XATO).

QOIDA (Coursebook 90-bet):
  AT + soat   (at 5 o'clock)
  ON + kun/sana (on Saturday, on 6th August)
  IN + oy/yil/fasl (in August, in 1963)

items.textEn: 4  John is OLDEST than Catherine.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja kerak.
'oldEST' — ORTTIRMA daraja → 'oldER'.
Unit 12 qoidasi:
  'than' → qiyosiy, 'the ... of/in' → orttirma.

items.textEn: 5  The football team played GOOD yesterday.
items.whyUz:
'played' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
good (SIFAT) → WELL (RAVISH).
'played good' XATO.
Unit 11 qoidasi; Coursebook 91-bet, 7-mashqning
7-bandi ham aynan shu.

items.textEn: 6  Pablo Picasso DIDN'T PAINTED the Mona Lisa.
items.whyUz:
'DIDN'T' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
'didn't PAINT' ✓  ('didn't painted' XATO).

ESLATMA: 'Mona Liza' ni aslida Leonardo da Vinchi
chizgan (Coursebook 73 va 85-betlarda ham
shu gap bor edi) — shuning uchun gap MANTIQAN
ham to'g'ri.

items.textEn: 7  Warsaw is the capital of THE POLAND.
items.whyUz:
Mamlakat nomlari oldidan 'THE' QO'YILMAYDI.
'of POLAND' ✓  ('of the Poland' XATO).

ISTISNOLAR (ko'plik yoki birlashma nomlar):
  the USA, the UK, the Netherlands,
  the Philippines.

Varshava — Polsha poytaxti (Coursebook 95-betda
ham uchragan).

items.textEn: 8  Could he PLAYED the piano when he was five?
items.whyUz:
'COULD' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
'Could he PLAY' ✓  ('Could he played' XATO).
Modal fe'llarning umumiy qoidasi:
keyin '-s' yo'q, '-ed' yo'q, 'to' yo'q.
Coursebook 90-bet, 6-mashqda ham 'could' bor edi.

items.textEn: 9  Would you like some SUGARS in your coffee?
items.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI.
'some SUGAR' ✓  ('some sugars' XATO).
Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') qoidasi.
Shunday: some water, some bread, some milk.

items.textEn: 10  WHEN is the new Chinese restaurant?
items.whyUz:
Restoran — JOY, vaqt emas.
'WHERE is the new Chinese restaurant?' ✓
= Yangi xitoy restorani QAYERDA?

'When' vaqt so'raydi — restoran uchun mos emas.
(Agar 'When is the new restaurant OPENING?'
bo'lsa to'g'ri bo'lardi, lekin gapda 'opening'
yo'q.)

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BIR BAND — 1-13 unitlarning UMUMIY TAKRORI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C  and
   2  B  will
   3  A  Were
   4  C  in
   5  C  loaves
   6  B  much
   7  A  work
   8  B  than
   9  C  had
  10  B  Few
  11  C  could


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Piter pardalarni tortdi va derazadan qaradi.
   2  Sizningcha, ertaga tumanli bo'ladimi?
   3  Kecha kutubxonada edingizmi?
   4  O'sha kunlarda odamlarda vodoprovod suvi
      yo'q edi.
   5  Bizga qancha non kerak?
   6  Qancha shakar xohlaysiz?
   7  Antoni shu yerda ishlaydimi?
   8  U akasidan og'irroq.
   9  Bugun ertalab bir stakan sut ichdim.
  10  1950-yilda kam odamda televizor bor edi.
  11  U besh yoshida o'qiy olardi.


HAR BIRI QAYSI MAVZUNI TEKShIRADI:

   1  BOG'LOVChI: 'and' (ketma-ket ikki harakat)
      Piter avval pardani tortdi, KEYIN qaradi.
      'because' — sabab (mos emas),
      'when' — vaqt (mos emas).

   2  'DO YOU THINK it ...... be foggy?'
      Kelajak haqida TAXMIN → WILL.
      'don't' va 'can' mos emas.
      Unit 13.

   3  '...... you in the library YESTERDAY?'
      'you' + o'tgan zamon → WERE.
      'Was' — birlik uchun ('I', 'he', 'she',
      'it').
      'Wasn't' — inkor (savolda mos emas).

   4  'IN those days' — turg'un ibora
      (o'sha kunlarda).
      'on those days' / 'at those days' XATO.
      'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.

   5  'How MANY ...... of bread?'
      'many' → KO'PLIK ot kerak → LOAVES.
      'loaf' → 'LOAVES' (noto'g'ri ko'plik).
      'a loaf of bread' = bir non.
      Unit 8 (o'lchov iboralari).

   6  'How ...... SUGAR do you want?'
      'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
      'how many' — sanaladigan otlar bilan.
      Unit 8.

   7  'DOES Anthony ...... here?'
      'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl → WORK.
      'works' XATO ('-s' allaqachon 'does' da).
      Unit 5.

   8  'He is heavier ...... his brother.'
      'heavIER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
      Unit 12.

   9  'I ...... a glass of milk THIS MORNING.'
      'this morning' — o'tgan vaqt → PAST SIMPLE.
      have → HAD.
      'did' va 'have' mos emas.

  10  '...... people owned a television in 1950.'
      'people' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) → FEW.
      'little' — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan.
      'any' — so'roq/inkor gaplarda.
      'FEW people' = kam odam.

  11  'She ...... read WHEN SHE WAS FIVE.'
      'when she WAS five' — O'TGAN zamon →
      COULD.
      'can' — hozirgi zamon,
      'can't' — hozirgi inkor.
      Unit 9.


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

   5  'How many LOAVES of bread' —
      'bread' sanalmaydigan, lekin 'loaf'
      SANALADIGAN. Shuning uchun 'how MANY'.
      Ko'plik: loaf → LOAVES ('f' → 'ves').

   6  'How much SUGAR' —
      5-band bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda 'many'
      (loaves — sanaladigan), bu yerda 'much'
      (sugar — sanalmaydigan).

  10  'FEW people' —
      'few' SANALADIGAN, 'little' SANALMAYDIGAN.
      'people' — sanaladigan ko'plik → FEW.


NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR:
     loaf   →  LOAVES
     knife  →  KNIVES
     leaf   →  LEAVES
     wife   →  WIVES
     life   →  LIVES
  ('-f' yoki '-fe' → '-VES')

items.textEn: 1  Peter drew the curtains ............ looked out of the window.
items.uz: Piter pardalarni tortdi va derazadan qaradi.
items.whyUz:
AND — ketma-ket ikki harakat.
Piter avval pardani tortdi, KEYIN qaradi.
'because' — sabab (mos emas),
'when' — vaqt (mos emas).
'draw the curtains' = pardalarni tortmoq.

items.textEn: 2  Do you think it ............ be foggy tomorrow?
items.whyUz:
WILL — kelajak haqida TAXMIN.
'Do you THINK ...' — fikr so'ralmoqda.
'tomorrow' — kelajak vaqti.
Unit 13 qoidasi.

items.textEn: 3  ............ you in the library yesterday?
items.whyUz:
'you' + O'TGAN zamon ('yesterday') → WERE.
'Was' — birlik uchun (I, he, she, it).
'Wasn't' — inkor, savolda mos emas.

items.textEn: 4  People didn't have running water ............ those days.
items.uz: O'sha kunlarda odamlarda vodoprovod suvi yo'q edi.
items.whyUz:
'IN those days' — TURG'UN ibora
(o'sha kunlarda, o'sha paytlarda).
'on those days' / 'at those days' XATO.
'running water' = vodoprovod suvi.

items.textEn: 5  How many ............ of bread do we need?
items.whyUz:
'How MANY' → KO'PLIK ot kerak → LOAVES.
'loaf' — birlik, 'slice' — birlik.

NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIK: loaf → LOAVES
('-f' → '-VES').
Shunday: knife→knives, leaf→leaves,
wife→wives, life→lives.
'a loaf of bread' = bir non.

items.textEn: 6  How ............ sugar do you want?
items.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → HOW MUCH.
'how many' — SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.

DIQQAT — 5-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  'How MANY loaves' (loaf — sanaladigan)
  'How MUCH sugar'  (sugar — sanalmaydigan)

items.textEn: 7  Does Anthony ............ here?
items.whyUz:
'DOES' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli → WORK.
'Does he works' XATO — '-s' allaqachon 'does'
da bor.
'Does he working' XATO.
Unit 5 qoidasi.

items.textEn: 8  He is heavier ............ his brother.
items.whyUz:
'heavIER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'heavier from' / 'heavier to' XATO.
Unit 12 qoidasi.

items.textEn: 9  I ............ a glass of milk this morning.
items.uz: Bugun ertalab bir stakan sut ichdim.
items.whyUz:
'THIS MORNING' — allaqachon o'tgan vaqt →
PAST SIMPLE.
have → HAD.
'have a glass of milk' = bir stakan sut ichmoq.

items.textEn: 10  ............ people owned a television in 1950.
items.whyUz:
'people' — SANALADIGAN (ko'plik) → FEW.
'little' — SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan
(little water, little time).
'any' — so'roq va inkor gaplarda.
'FEW people' = kam odam.

items.textEn: 11  She ............ read when she was five.
items.whyUz:
'when she WAS five' — O'TGAN zamon → COULD.
'can' — hozirgi zamon,
'can't' — hozirgi inkor.
'could' = o'tmishdagi QOBILIYAT.
Unit 9 qoidasi.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar 59-bet — It/There, sabab-natija-maqsad va 1-13 unitlarning takrori.

items.derivedUz: It will be hot in Rome.
There will be rain in Ankara.
Tom has toothache, so he is going to visit the dentist.

items.base: ega + is going to ... BECAUSE + ega + wants to ...
items.derivedUz: Cindy is going to save money because she wants to buy a car.

items.base: ega + is going to ... TO + ASOSIY fe'l
items.derivedUz: Cindy is going to save money to buy a car.
→ It will be FOGGY / THERE will be fog

patterns.formula: THERE WILL BE + OT.   /   IT WILL BE + SIFAT.
patterns.exampleEn: There will be fewer cars in the future. It will be foggy in London tomorrow.
patterns.exampleUz: Kelajakda mashinalar kamroq bo'ladi. Ertaga Londonda tumanli bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
OT → THERE, SIFAT → IT.
FEWER + sanaladigan, LESS + sanalmaydigan.

patterns.formula: [SABAB], SO + ega + IS GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Tom has toothache, so he is going to visit the dentist.
patterns.exampleUz: Tomning tishi og'riyapti, shuning uchun u tish shifokoriga bormoqchi.

patterns.formula: ega + IS GOING TO + fe'l + BECAUSE + ega + WANTS TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Cindy is going to save money because she wants to buy a car.
patterns.exampleUz: Sindi pul yig'moqchi, chunki mashina sotib olmoqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because' — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor.

patterns.formula: How MANY + KO'PLIK ot ?   /   How MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN ot ?
patterns.exampleEn: How many loaves of bread do we need? How much sugar do you want?
patterns.exampleUz: Bizga qancha non kerak? Qancha shakar xohlaysiz?

patterns.formula: ega + COULD + ASOSIY fe'l + when + ega + WAS ... .
patterns.exampleEn: She could read when she was five.
patterns.explanationUz:
O'TGAN zamondagi QOBILIYAT → COULD.
'could' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.
